Entire Thakkar family is worried because there is no sign of Anju at home or around the society. They are even more worried because the prospective bride’s family is coming home soon. So everyone heads out to search for Anju but they also have to make sure that the word does not go around that Anju is missing. Where is Anju? Will they be able to find her?
Keep watching to know what happens next in this hilarious story
